why: The paired case for noverify-20, and the one that stops the prefix match from growing into a substring match. `--no-ver` is ambiguous between `--no-verify` and `--no-verbose`; git refuses to run it, so it skips nothing and denying it would be the guard refusing a command that cannot do the thing it is guarding against. The over-strict direction is not free here — it is how a guard earns the reputation that gets it switched off.
